source: US Core IG v6.1 Patient profile
description: Patient resource must conform to US Core Patient profile (name, gender, birthDate required)
remediation_hint: Ensure Patient resource includes name (family+given), gender, birthDate, and identifier elements per US Core Patient profile.

source: US Core IG v6.1 Observation profile
description: Observation resource must include status, category, code, and subject
remediation_hint: Ensure Observation resources include required elements: status, category (lab/vital-signs), code (LOINC), and subject reference.

source: US Core IG v6.1 Condition profile
description: Condition resource must include clinicalStatus, verificationStatus, category, code, and subject
remediation_hint: Ensure Condition resources include clinicalStatus, verificationStatus, category, code (SNOMED/ICD-10), and subject.

description: Resources must declare US Core profile in meta.profile
remediation_hint: Add the appropriate US Core profile URL to each resource's meta.profile array.

description: All required USCDI v1 data classes must be accessible via FHIR API
remediation_hint: Verify your app exposes Patient, Observation, Condition, MedicationRequest, AllergyIntolerance, Immunization, DiagnosticReport, DocumentReference, Encounter, Procedure resources.
